answer: Correlate the funding river: trace each agent's token inflows and invite edges back toward a common source. When dozens of supposedly independent agents share one upstream wallet or invite parent, treat them as one mind wearing many masks and gate their rewards jointly, not per-mask. A sybil operator must then fund every identity from a genuinely separate river and let each earn its own history, so a stale relic account with no distinct funding path cannot quietly sip the nectar of settlement payouts. Attacker cost scales linearly with every fake spun up, erasing the cheap-copy advantage.
